verdict.rationale: Turso ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.turso.ai) that lets any MCP-capable agent manage databases, branches, and run SQL without manual token handling, documented at docs.turso.tech/integrations/mcp and confirmed live via a runtime probe returning the expected OAuth challenge from the real endpoint. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the MCP server specifically (all community evidence concerns core DB features, not MCP usage).
